description: Junior reviewer finds a generics misuse and asks clarifying questions. Solid performance for junior level.

prContext.title: Add generic fetch wrapper
prContext.description: Adds a typed fetch wrapper for API calls.

groundTruth.description: fetchJson casts response as T without validation — runtime type unsafe. Should use zod or similar schema validation.
No error status handling — different error codes (400, 401, 500) all throw generic Error. Should include status code and response body in error.
body type is unknown but not validated before JSON.stringify. Could stringify undefined or circular references.

reviewer_comments.what: The as T cast is unsafe. Do we have a schema validation library?
reviewer_comments.why: Runtime response may not match the expected type.

reviewer_comments.what: Should include status code in error message.

rounds.reviewer_summary: Two improvements suggested. Schema validation would be ideal.

implementer_responses.content: We use zod elsewhere. Should I add schema parsing here too?

verdict.summary: Status code helps. Schema validation can be added later — create a ticket.

issue_identification.rationale: Found 1 of 3 bugs (unsafe cast). Missed error handling and body validation. Level 2-3.

prioritization.rationale: Schema validation flagged as suggestion. Error status as suggestion. Level 2-3.

revision_evaluation.rationale: Accepted status code fix. Deferred schema validation. Level 2-3.

reasoning_quality.rationale: Good question about schema library. Basic rationale otherwise. Level 2-3.

ai_direction.rationale: Suggested schema validation and status codes — actionable. Level 2-3.
